summary: Chat-first Windows/Android/Web client update: per-peer unread indicators, foreground notification settings, smoother native chats and mobile touch navigation; LoopRD server descriptor unchanged.

implemented.title: Replace oversized Windows client with native buddy list and separate conversations
implemented.summary: Windows main window is roster-sized instead of 1060px dashboard. Open individual Tauri chat windows and broker authenticated operations via main window without copying credentials. Build emits standalone chat page, leaves Android/web responsive, and adds native geometry/IPC checks.
operator_checks: Install the Windows NSIS artifact; sign-in opens as a narrow 355×630 window, with no blue 1060px background or a duplicate app title bar.
Sign in with an existing Social account; the same window displays buddy groups and turn alerts; verify there is no permanent right-side panel.
Double-click a buddy or open Community Lobby: a separate approximately 585×525 Windows chat window opens, and reselecting the same buddy focuses it.
Send and receive a message in the native conversation; verify chat windows do not need another login and can open simultaneously.
Verify Settings/Games/Portrait and server-authorized developer switch work within the roster-sized native host.
Run the Web, Windows and Android workflows; confirm Android navigation and browser API/account parity remain functional.

implemented.title: Server-promoted browser games and Windows companion lobby chat
implemented.summary: Server operator publishes HTTPS game allowlist using TAVI_GAME_CATALOG_JSON; client shows catalog; isolated Tauri game window displays sandboxed game iframe and authenticated lobby chat via main-only request broker. External-browser fallback supported.
operator_checks: Set TAVI_GAME_CATALOG_JSON to a reviewed HTTPS game URL on the Social server and redeploy the generated LoopRD handler.
Refresh games in Tavi; verify only server-promoted games appear.
Open promoted embedded web game on Windows; verify separate window and community lobby chat while playing.
Test browser refusal to frame: open browser fallback; verify no Social token is disclosed to embedded game.
Verify Windows NSIS and web build before deployment.

implemented.title: Local client build and explicit descriptor deployment check
implemented.summary: Provide PowerShell local Web, Windows and verify build entrypoints and read-only Git HEAD comparison for looprd.yaml; no automatic push or release deployment.
operator_checks: Run BUILD-LOCAL.ps1 -Target Web on Windows with dependencies installed and inspect client/dist.
Run BUILD-LOCAL.ps1 -Target Windows with Rust/MSVC toolchain and inspect NSIS installer.
Run CHECK-LOOPRD-DEPLOY.ps1 against unchanged and modified looprd.yaml in a Git checkout.

implemented.title: ZipRunner automatic local Tavi builds
implemented.summary: Windows default; Web/Android configurable; incremental digest and installer rollback; never pushes Git.
operator_checks: On Windows import source ZIP with working NSIS dependencies and confirm TAVI_AUTO_BUILD_PASSED in ZipRunner build log.
Reapply doc-only changes and confirm cached build when client sources unchanged.
Intentionally break native build, confirm job fails and previous NSIS installer remains.
Check looprd.yaml diff independently and publish server changes only when required.

implemented.title: Tavi visual identity and branded launcher assets
implemented.summary: Custom Tavi speech/leaf icon rendered to PNG/ICO from versioned SVG source; forest/teal accents on welcome/roster/chat/game window; Tavi web metadata and existing ZipRunner local Windows autobuild. No server descriptor changes.
operator_checks: Import into looprd-social ZipRunner and confirm 0.3.10 stamp.
Verify tests and Windows auto-build on Windows host; open installer and check taskbar/launcher icon.
Confirm compact roster and independent chat/game windows retain original size and layout.
Confirm client-only change does not require looprd.yaml publication.

implemented.title: Windows native build environment and SQLite cleanup reliability
implemented.summary: Temporary SQLite fixtures now close all connections before cleanup; local build establishes .venv and installs requirements-dev.txt without modifying global Python.
operator_checks: On Windows run BUILD-LOCAL.ps1 -Target Windows without manually activating a venv; verify Python tests pass without WinError 32 and compilation advances to Tauri.
Confirm TAVI_AUTO_BUILD_PASSED and a real NSIS executable before accepting native build; retain prior installer if a build fails.

implemented.title: Bind native WebView2 network requests correctly
implemented.summary: The shared JavaScript SDK now invokes window fetch on globalThis rather than calling a detached browser method. Adds a failing-before regression test that exercises discovery, account registration, and authenticated profile read.
operator_checks: Build and launch Tavi on Windows; connect to the existing server, register a NEW username with a >=12 character password, and verify a buddy list appears without Illegal invocation.
Close and reopen Tavi; sign in and check that contact list, direct messages and server catalog load.
Verify browser SDK tests and no looprd.yaml change; ensure no tokens are logged or sent to game URLs.

implemented.title: Remember Tavi login on Windows and Web
implemented.summary: Save a revocable server-scoped Social token after explicit opt-in and restore it only after authenticated me() validation. Session-only fallback, remembered-device setting, expiration guard and logout cleanup added; never persist passwords.
operator_checks: On Windows, sign in with Remember enabled, close Tavi, relaunch and confirm buddy list restores without a password.
Disable remembering, sign out, restart, and confirm the password is required.
Repeat with the standalone web client; confirm an invalid or revoked token is cleared and prompts for sign-in.
Verify no game iframe, external site or public endpoint receives the saved Social token.

implemented.title: Initial Tavi interactive event inbox
implemented.summary: Persistence and bounded action schemas in Social; reply controls and HTTPS links in client. Operator-authorized publisher only; LoopRD admin role automation and scoped web SSO remain future work.
operator_checks: Deploy schema v4 descriptor and activate server release 0.3.16; verify old accounts remain available.
Publish a test event from an operator-approved developer account; confirm recipient inbox displays it after refresh.
Reply once and verify replay is refused and state survives restart.
Open an HTTPS link and confirm no Social session token is sent to destination.
Confirm no permanent admin panel is added and old server behavior reports inbox unavailable rather than corrupting login.

implemented.title: Actionable and historical inbox UX with recipient dismissal
implemented.summary: Filters open/history events, renders transient native action forms, and atomically records dismissals for the authenticated recipient without schema changes.
operator_checks: Publish an event to one user and confirm it appears under Needs action only for that user.
Dismiss the event and verify it moves to History after refresh and restart.
Verify a different user cannot dismiss or reply to the event.
Open a safe HTTPS link and confirm the Social bearer is not forwarded to the destination.

implemented.title: Readable chat inbox with Windows and Android foreground alerts
implemented.summary: Per-peer unread counts in the contact roster, local read/notified cursors scoped by server and account, privacy-first OS notifications, separate-window read acknowledgments, composer-preserving conversation refresh, and phone-safe navigation. This is a client-only release; background mobile push remains future work.
operator_checks: On Windows with two accounts, verify new private messages show per-contact unread badges and native toast after OS permission; selecting/focusing the chat clears unread.
Send a private message while editing another draft in a separate native chat window: verify the draft/caret are preserved and the message arrives.
Restart Tavi and verify an already-notified message is not notified again; verify session tokens and message bodies are absent from unread-state localStorage records.
Install the Android client and verify 48px touch targets, safe-area navigation and foreground notifications when permission is granted.
Check that looprd.yaml is unchanged and no LoopRD server migration/deployment is required.

remaining.title: Account recovery and hardened public registration

remaining.summary: Buddy list/direct messages are implemented in this pass. Group conversation membership, game invitations, moderation and game ticket authorization still need Social and game-side contracts.

remaining.title: Android background push and turn delivery
remaining.summary: Turn notifications work while the client is running; provide Social-owned device push registration and a push provider to wake Android after app termination.

remaining.title: Native build and device acceptance
remaining.summary: Rebuild Windows NSIS, Android APK and Web assets for 0.3.4; confirm native multi-window messaging and updated compact window geometry; independently validate login and visuals on target platforms.

remaining.title: Game activity integration
remaining.summary: Each game hosted on the selected LoopRD server must implement its own turn-activity contract for automatic alerts; the Social app cannot fabricate turns.

remaining.title: Secure persistent device login
remaining.summary: Session restore implemented using client-local browser/WebView storage with an explicit remember-device choice. Native OS credential vault, device listing/revocation controls, and security hardening remain planned.

remaining.title: Embedded Life actual game acceptance
remaining.summary: Configure Life deployment URL via operator catalog, verify iframe policies, cookies, sign-in and actual game functionality. Life integration must be validated against its deployment.

remaining.title: Dedicated game session chat and invitations
remaining.summary: Companion currently uses existing shared community lobby; build room-scoped conversations and short-lived audience-bound game join tickets after agreeing game API contract.

remaining.title: Native game launch and overlay
remaining.summary: Design trusted local executable registration, user-consented launches, Windows overlay injection avoidance and platform support; no arbitrary remote command execution.

remaining.title: Web/Android integrated player
remaining.summary: Standalone browser and Android currently open promoted games in external browser; add secure embedded player with parity after WebView acceptance.

remaining.title: LoopRD role-driven routing and scoped panel SSO
remaining.summary: Requires LoopRD/DAPI admin-principal contracts, external publisher identity, durable role-driven subscriptions and one-time destination-scoped web handoff.

remaining.title: Server-backed inbox heads and background mobile push
remaining.summary: Specify and build server-side DM summaries and synchronized read state; later add authenticated mobile push enrollment, safe push payloads, Android FCM and proper delivery diagnostics. Do not claim closed-app mobile notifications.
